text: Did you know your body has its own repair system?
The moment you get a cut, an incredible process begins inside your body.
First, your blood forms a clot to stop the bleeding and protect the wound.
Then, your immune cells rush to the area, fighting harmful bacteria and clearing away damaged cells.
Your body starts producing new tissue, building tiny blood vessels, and creating new skin to close the wound.
All of this happens without you even thinking about it!
So, how does your body protect itself from stomach acid?
